items.title: Tackling Europe’s Democratic Blind Spots with Citizen-Driven Insights
items.description:
European democracy has many faces. Everyone talks about it, but no one can really define it. It is a concept understood and experienced so differently that there is no single, straightforward definition of it. Nor are the ways to protect and promote it.  
But what exactly is democracy? Do you know?  
There are so many blind spots, as this year's report from the European Democracy Hub shows. Our Sense Maker can already provide some insights into how European citizens experience and understand democracy through metaphors.

items.title: How can the Sense Maker help in VUCA environments and the use of metaphors?
items.description:
We live in challenging times, characterized by Volatility, Uncertainty, Complexity and Ambiguity. 😵‍💫  
The recent election of Trump will contribute to those type of political environments all around us.  
Politicians and citizens will need an innovative and powerful approach to navigate through and build on future resilience.

items.title: Bridging Citizens and Policymakers: How SenseMaker Enhances Democratic Participation
items.description:
In a democracy, meaningful engagement between citizens and their representatives is crucial for effective and inclusive policymaking. In a **healthy** democracy, citizens need a voice in shaping policies that impact their lives. This requires tools that not only gather their opinions but also capture the complexities, emotions, and stories behind them.

While **Traditional Surveys** have long been used for gathering public opinion, they can fall short in capturing the full picture, particularly in complex or nuanced situations.
